speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I can see you're struggling with double vision, weakness in your arms, and difficulty climbing stairs. To understand the cause of these symptoms, can you tell me how long you've had these issues and if they worsen with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening with activity and improving with rest is highly suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder, but the double vision also points to a specific cranial nerve involvement. Have you ever experienced similar episodes of weakness that resolved completely on their own? REQUEST TEST: Serum_AChR_Antibody; REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation.
